spells.name: Disruption
spells.description:
Teleports the target symmetrically in relation to the caster and steals HP in the Fire element from enemies.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Cog
spells.description:
Teleports targets symmetrically in relation to the centre and steals HP in the Earth element from enemies in an area of effect.
Does not directly affect the caster.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Frostbite
spells.description:
Teleports the target to its previous position and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Dust
spells.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Also teleports Telefrag targets in the area of effect symmetrically in relation to the centre before applying effects.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Souvenir
spells.description:
Teleports the target to its previous position and steals HP in the Air element from enemies.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Permutation
spells.description:
Switches places with the target and steals HP in the Water element from enemies.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Xelor's Punch
spells.description:
Teleports the target symmetrically in relation to the caster and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Pendulum
spells.description:
Teleports the caster symmetrically in relation to the target, inflicts Air damage on the targeted enemy and on enemies in an area of effect around the caster, and teleports the caster to their previous position.
The effects are applied only once per casting.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Accomplice
spells.description:
Summons a controllable Accomplice that serves as an obstacle.
The Accomplice gains MP when it enters the Telefrag state.
It also reflects part of the damage it suffers from its summoner onto enemies in an area of effect around it.

If the caster's Accomplice is still on the field when summoned again, the old one is destroyed to make room for the new one.

spells.name: Xelor's Dial
spells.description:
Summons a static Xelor's Dial that can remove AP from or give AP to Telefrag entities in an area of effect.
It can also reflect part of the damage it suffers onto its enemy attackers. It also reflects part of the damage it suffers from the caster onto enemies in an area of effect around it.

There can only be one Xelor's Dial per team. If the Dial is still on the field when summoned again, the old one is destroyed to make room for the new one.

spells.name: Teleportation
spells.description:
Teleports the caster symmetrically relative to the target.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

The cooldown is reset when the caster generates or consumes a Telefrag.

spells.name: Astrolabe
spells.description:
Teleports the caster to the targeted cell or switches places with the target.

On the caster: teleports them to their previous position.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

The cooldown is reset when the caster generates or consumes a Telefrag.

spells.name: Shrivelling
spells.description:
Inflicts Air damage.
If the target has Telefrag, the spell's damage increases each time it is cast.

spells.name: Hand

buffs: Removes the effects of rank 0 of the 5 spell
Removes the effects of rank 0 of the 6 spell

spells.description:
Applies a start-of-turn Earth poison and the Hand state on the target:
• Inflicts Earth damage if the target loses the Telefrag state.

Damage can only be triggered once per turn.

spells.name: Gear
spells.description:
Teleports targets symmetrically in relation to the centre and inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.
The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance.
Does not directly affect the caster.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Dropper
spells.description:
Teleports the target and the caster to their previous positions and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Passage of Time
spells.description:
Increases the targeted ally's Dodge.
Teleports the target back to its previous position on the following turn.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Premonition
spells.description:
Teleports the caster or switches their position with the entity on the targeted cell on the following turn.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Dark Ray
spells.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect.
The spell's damage increases for each Telefrag entity in the area of effect before applying effects.
The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance.

Consumes the targets' {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}} states.

spells.name: Drying Up
spells.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies.
Rebounds on the nearest entity in a 2-cell circle.
Also increases the caster's MP for each Telefrag entity that is hit.

Consumes the targets' {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}} states.

spells.name: Slow Down
spells.description:
Removes AP and inflicts Water damage.
If the target has Telefrag, steals instead of removing.

spells.name: Xelor's Sandglass
spells.description:
Removes AP from and inflicts Fire damage on enemies and applies the Sandglass state on the target:
• Inflicts delayed Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect.

The delay is reduced for each Telefrag consumed on the target.

spells.name: Temporal Haze
spells.description:
Immediately removes unparryable AP in an area of effect to increase them on the following turn.
The AP removal does not affect the caster.

spells.name: Conservation
spells.description:
Reduces damage suffered by the targeted ally and applies the Conservation state on the ally:
• Increases the target's AP for each enemy attack (stackable 2 times).

spells.name: Rhol Bak
spells.description:
Teleports everyone to their previous positions.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Instability
spells.description:
Places a start-of-turn glyph that teleports targets to their previous positions.
Also places a glyph-aura that makes allies Unlockable and removes AP from enemies.

The glyph is triggered if the caster generates or consumes a Telefrag.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Clock
spells.description:
Removes AP and inflicts Earth damage.
If the target has Telefrag, the spell's damage increases before its effects are applied.

Consumes the target's {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}} state.

spells.name: Water Clock
spells.description:
Removes AP and inflicts Water damage.
Increases the caster's AP on the following turn if the target has Telefrag (stackable 3 times).

Consumes the target's {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}} state.

spells.name: Refraction
spells.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies.
If the target has Telefrag, spreads the Telefrag state and applies the effects in an area of effect.

Consumes the target's {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}} state.

spells.name: Regulator
spells.description:
Reduces the duration of effects on the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.
Increases the spell's maximum number of casts per turn for the current turn if the target has Telefrag.

Consumes the target's {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}} state.

spells.name: Rewind
spells.description:
Teleports the target to its start-of-turn position.
If the target is an ally, effects are applied at the end of the target's turn.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Remanence
spells.description:
Applies the Remanent state on the target:
• Teleports the target to its previous position for every MP the target uses.
• If the target is an ally, effects are applied at the end of the target's turn.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Paradox
spells.description:
On the caster's Accomplice or Xelor's Dial:
• Makes the summons Unmovable.
• Teleports entities symmetrically in relation to the summons in an area of effect around it.
• Sets the cooldown period of the caster's Accomplice and Xelor's Dial spells to 1 turn.
• At the start of the summons's turn, teleports these entities teleported symmetrically in relation to the summons again.

Does not affect the Synchro or the caster.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Rift
spells.description:
Switches places with the caster's Accomplice or Xelor's Dial and sets their cooldown period to 1 turn.
At the end of the caster's turn, teleports the Accomplice or Dial to its previous position.

Prevents Telefrag from being applied on the Synchro for the current turn.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Petrification
spells.description:
Inflicts Water damage and removes AP.
If the target has Telefrag, the spell's AP cost is reduced after being cast (stackable 2 times).

Consumes the target's {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}} state.

spells.name: Harmpit
spells.description:
Removes AP from and inflicts Air damage on enemies.
If the target has Telefrag, the spell inflicts extra Air damage on enemies in an area of effect on the targeted cell at the end of the caster's next turn.

Consumes the target's {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}} state.

spells.name: Distortion
spells.description:
Teleports targets to their previous positions and inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect.
The area-of-effect damage does not decrease with distance.
Does not affect the caster.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Sands of Time
spells.description:
Teleports the target to its previous position and inflicts Fire damage on enemies.
Rebounds on the nearest entity in a 2-cell circle.

The rebound originates at each target's starting position.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Desynchronisation
spells.description:
Places a single-cell trap that teleports entities symmetrically in relation to the trap in an area of effect.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Spacetime
spells.description:
Applies the Spacetime state on the target:
• Teleports the target and the target's attacker to their previous positions if it suffers damage.
• Also reflects part of the damage suffered by the target onto their attacker if a Telefrag enemy.

Can generate a {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}}.

spells.name: Mummification
spells.description: Applies the Telefrag state on the caster, makes them Unlockable and increases their MP and their AP Reduction.

spells.name: Twenty-Fifth Hour
spells.description: Deactivates the Rooted, Unmovable and Gravity states on the caster for the current turn.

spells.name: Synchro
spells.description:
Summons a static Synchro that may inflict Air damage on enemies in an area of effect when it enters the Telefrag state.
The Synchro is destroyed after inflicting damage.

It is immune to the direct application of Telefrag, and to the end-of-turn effects of the Rewind and Remanence spells.

There can only be one Synchro per team. If the Synchro is still on the field when summoned again, the old one is destroyed to make room for the new one.

spells.name: Knell
spells.description:
Inflicts Fire, Water, Air and Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.

Damage is increased for each Telefrag consumed since it was last cast.
The effects are removed after the spell has been used.

Requires consuming at least one {{spell,24510,1::<color=#ebc304>Telefrag</color>}} to be used.
